admission.justification: Condition 1 is realized in landing_commit_check.py (_borrow_dashboard_node_modules and _lockfile_borrow_refusal) and Condition 2 is realized across _code_merge_commit.py (sync_merge_commit_args) and _merge.py (_commit_staged_merge), and all five R8 tests in test_sync_commit_check.py and test_landing_commit_check.py guard both conditions.

applicability: Sync merge commits that run a repository pre-commit hook and landing or integration commit checks that run in a linked or temporary checkout carrying dashboard/package.json.
conditions: Commit-Check-Pass is appended via git commit -m onto the comment-stripped MERGE_MSG only when resolve_commit_check_hook resolves a runnable hook.

dashboard/node_modules borrowing runs only when dashboard/package.json exists, candidate dashboard/node_modules is absent, primary dashboard/node_modules exists, both dashboard/package-lock.json files are byte-identical, and dashboard/node_modules/ is gitignored.
exclusions: Non-conflicting code merges in start_side_merge, which run plain git merge --no-edit with no Commit-Check-Pass stamp.
Repositories without dashboard/package.json or checkouts that already have their own dashboard/node_modules.

evidence: Reviewer R3 PASS WITH NOTES on 05acc9a7 (L29-W3-final-checks-05acc9a7.log: 243 passed, 84 subtests passed; R8 tests (i)-(v) in test_sync_commit_check.py and test_landing_commit_check.py)

statement: A sync merge commit whose runnable pre-commit hook passed records Commit-Check-Pass: tree=<tree> hook=<actual hook>, and no stamp is written when the repository has no runnable hook or the hook is disabled; a commit check running in a temporary or linked checkout borrows the primary checkout's dashboard/node_modules only when the candidate and primary dashboard/package-lock.json are byte-identical and dashboard/node_modules/ is gitignored, unlinking the symlink in finally, and otherwise refuses pre-spawn as unrunnable with no npm install and no leftover link.
title: Synced hooks carry tree-bound stamps; temp checkouts borrow matching deps
